finalText:
**Fixed. All 625 tests pass.**

Only three cases were ever red. All three were in `order totals`.

`orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` charged tax on the full price. It should charge tax on the discounted price. Then it added that tax on, instead of taxing the discounted total.

Most rows had a zero discount or zero tax, which hid it. Only rows with both showed the gap.

The fix reuses `applyTax` on the discounted amount.
